# Project index (product repository)

Use this file **inside a product or work repository** that holds more than one
distinct project or user-facing surface. Do not copy filled rows into the
public Agentic Governance repository.

Replace every placeholder before use. Public framework git must keep this
template’s placeholder names only (`Project A`, `path/to/a/`).

## Bottom line

This index lists the projects in *this* repository, where they live, what
each one is for, and how they relate. It is local operating context for
people who work in this product tree.

## Index

| Project | Path(s) | Purpose | Related projects |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project A | `path/to/a/` | Short purpose for surface A | Depends on Project B |
| Project B | `path/to/b/` | Short purpose for surface B | Serves Project A |

## Entry fields

1. **Project** — a local name for the distinct project or surface.
2. **Path(s)** — repository-relative path(s) only. Do not publish absolute host paths.
3. **Purpose** — one or two sentences.
4. **Related projects** — how this entry connects to others in the same repository.

## Maintenance

When a new distinct project or surface is added to this repository, add or
update the matching row the same day.

## Privacy

Personal product names, private host paths, emails, and other personal data
must not be copied from a filled index into public Agentic Governance git.
The public framework stores only this placeholder shape.
